verdict.rationale: Security support for older major versions is a fair question for a web framework, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never describes a support or LTS policy, backported security patches, or a maintenance window for prior majors. Codemods and upgrade guides help with migration, but they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can continue receiving security updates for an older major version while I plan my migration
